description: This file defines classes and functions for Windows SSPI-based HTTP authentication mechanisms, including SSPI library abstraction, default implementation, and specific HttpAuth mechanism for SSPI. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external references related to Windows security APIs.

classes.name: SSPILibrary
classes.description: Abstract class representing SSPI library operations for Windows security packages.

classes.name: SSPILibraryDefault
classes.description: Default implementation of SSPILibrary that calls Windows SSPI functions.

classes.name: HttpAuthSSPI
classes.description: Http authentication mechanism using Windows SSPI API.

methods.name: DetermineMaxTokenLength
methods.description: Determines the maximum token length for a given SSPI package.

methods.name: AcquireCredentialsHandle
methods.description: Obtains a handle to the credentials for SSPI authentication.

methods.name: InitializeSecurityContext
methods.description: Initializes security context for SSPI authentication.

methods.name: QueryContextAttributesEx
methods.description: Queries extended attributes of a security context.

methods.name: QuerySecurityPackageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a security package.

methods.name: FreeContextBuffer
methods.description: Frees a buffer allocated by SSPI.

methods.description:

ame string into separate domain and username parts.
